_comment: Merge this into ~/.nanobot/config.json for HKUDS nanobot (github.com/HKUDS/nanobot).
MCP servers live under tools.mcpServers. Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH with your clone path —
nanobot launches the process itself, so a relative path will not resolve.
toolTimeout is set above the 30s default on purpose: hyperliquid_carry fans out across
the perp universe and takes ~5s on a good connection, more on conference wifi.
